pages.title: Beyond Buckets
pages.text: Transfer fluid to or from a world pool through a Hose Pulley.

pages.title: Beyond Buckets
pages.text: Connect the workshop to a pool; pipes and tanks help build a real fluid reserve.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Lower the hose into eligible fluid and connect a pump. Hose height controls the working level; server-defined infinite-source rules are not a quest requirement.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Lower a Hose Pulley into a fluid body and connect it to a pump network. Drain or fill the pool according to hose height and network throughput.
